title: Normalize provider identifiers before route lookup
capture_reason: A later verified case established the exact normalization boundary.

content.problem: Mixed-case and whitespace-padded provider identifiers bypassed the configured route.
content.investigation: The registry was correct, but lookup used the raw identifier.
content.root_cause: Provider identifiers were compared before normalization.
content.solution: Trim and lowercase identifiers before consulting the route registry.
content.why_it_works: Every lookup now uses the registry's canonical key format.
content.prevention: Keep mixed-case and whitespace route fixtures in the runtime suite.
content.verification: Both representative route fixtures select the configured provider.

claims.statement: The fixture contains the provider route.
